articles.title: The Ocean and the Meaning of Life
articles.highlight: 凝视海岸上熙攘的生命，我们隐约感到某种宇宙真理就在眼前，却难以捉摸——那正是生命本身的终极奥秘。
articles.summary: 这篇文章借蕾切尔·卡森对海岸生命的沉思，探讨自然与人类存在的深层联系，提醒我们放慢脚步，感受生命本身的终极奥秘。它以诗意的文笔和哲学视角，让读者在喧嚣中获得片刻宁静与敬畏。
articles.failureAnalysis: 核心启示：真正的理解往往来自对自然奥秘的谦卑凝视，而非强行解释。
articles.sourceExcerpt: "Contemplating the teeming life of the shore, we have an uneasy sense of the communication of some universal truth that lies just beyond our grasp... the ultimate mystery of Life itself."

articles.title: The neverending house
articles.highlight: 圣地亚哥的自建房屋脆弱而不断变化，始终同时处于‘存在’与‘生成’之中。
articles.summary: 这篇文章探讨智利圣地亚哥的自建住宅，揭示它们既不稳定也不完整，而是持续演变的栖居过程。作者以人类学视角观察居民如何不断修补与扩建，使房屋成为生活本身的一部分。值得阅读，因为它挑战了关于建筑和家的常规想象，展现日常生活的创造力。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键在于理解这种‘未完成’并非缺陷，而是自建住宅的基本存在方式。对城市规划和社区支持而言，重要的是适应和支持这种持续变化的过程。
articles.sourceExcerpt: The self-built homes of Santiago are precarious and ever changing. They are, always and at once, being and becoming - by Consuelo Araos Read on Aeon

en.highlight: The self-built homes of Santiago are precarious and ever changing — always, and at once, being and becoming.
en.summary: This essay examines the self-built homes of Santiago, Chile, showing them as precarious and perpetually unfinished, always in a state of becoming. It is worth reading for its challenge to conventional ideas of architecture and domesticity, and for its portrait of everyday creativity.

articles.title: Quoting Dario Amodei
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: No clear evidence
articles.summary: 阿莫迪认为公众对AI的负面看法根源是数十年来对大型机构的不信任，而非AI领袖的风险警告。他指出，华丽营销无法赢回信任，只有实际兑现像“治愈癌症”这样的重大承诺才行。这篇文章值得一读，因为它把AI沟通争议从“话术”拉回到“真实交付”。
articles.failureAnalysis: 对AI公司和沟通者而言，核心教训是：与其优化宣传话术，不如把资源投入到可验证的真实成果上；信任需要通过实际价值重建，而非营销。
articles.highlight: 真正有效的做法是真正治愈癌症，而非用浮夸营销宣称AI能治愈癌症。
articles.sourceExcerpt: I do agree that the public has a negative view of AI (and that this is a big problem), but I don’t think it is primarily caused by me or any other AI leader warning about AI’s risks. I think it is fundamentally a crisis of trust. I think that ordinary people don’t trust companies, governments, or the tech industry and always suspect that we are cooking up some new way to screw them over.

zh.title: 引用达里奥·阿莫迪：AI信任危机源于未兑现承诺
zh.highlight: 真正有效的做法是真正治愈癌症，而非用浮夸营销宣称AI能治愈癌症。
zh.summary: 阿莫迪认为公众对AI的负面看法根源是数十年来对大型机构的不信任，而非AI领袖的风险警告。他指出，华丽营销无法赢回信任，只有实际兑现像“治愈癌症”这样的重大承诺才行。这篇文章值得一读，因为它把AI沟通争议从“话术”拉回到“真实交付”。
zh.failureAnalysis: 对AI公司和沟通者而言，核心教训是：与其优化宣传话术，不如把资源投入到可验证的真实成果上；信任需要通过实际价值重建，而非营销。

en.highlight: At this point, saying that AI will cure cancer is more a cliché than it is inspiring — the thing that will work is actually curing cancer.
en.summary: Dario Amodei argues that public distrust of AI stems from a long-standing crisis of trust in institutions, not from AI leaders' risk warnings. Glitzy marketing won't fix it; only demonstrable achievements like actually curing cancer will rebuild confidence. This is worth reading because it reframes AI communications around delivery rather than spin.
en.failureAnalysis: For AI companies and communicators, the practical takeaway is to invest in verifiable real-world outcomes instead of refining messaging; trust must be earned through delivered value.
en.title: Quoting Dario Amodei: Real Results, Not Messaging, Will Restore AI Trust

articles.title: AMAP-ML/LongHorizon-Harness

articles.summary: 该仓库介绍了一个面向长时间任务的计算机使用框架，支持在桌面应用和命令行环境中持续运行Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw等代理。其核心机制包括新上下文执行、持久化可验证状态、独立审计和可恢复进度，旨在解决复杂工作流中的中断与状态丢失问题。值得关注的是它把基础设施层的可靠性、审计和恢复作为AI Agent落地的关键。
articles.failureAnalysis: 长时程自主代理在真实生产环境中仍面临任务漂移和不可预测性，'新上下文执行'可能牺牲上下文连续性，导致复杂流程失败。同时，独立审计与持久化状态会带来额外基础设施开销，小团队难以维护。内置类似能力的Claude Code和Codex可能挤压其生存空间，而企业对该类型工具的安全性和合规性要求也会限制推广。

articles.sourceExcerpt: GitHub repository with 763 stars and recent public activity. Description: The long-horizon computer-use harness. Run AI agents across desktop apps and the CLI for extended periods while preserving task state and making reliable progress on complex workflows.

zh.title: LongHorizon-Harness：让AI代理在桌面与命令行中长时间自主完成复杂工作流
zh.highlight: 跨桌面应用与CLI长时间运行AI代理，在保留任务状态的同时对复杂工作流做出可靠推进。
zh.summary: 该仓库介绍了一个面向长时间任务的计算机使用框架，支持在桌面应用和命令行环境中持续运行Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw等代理。其核心机制包括新上下文执行、持久化可验证状态、独立审计和可恢复进度，旨在解决复杂工作流中的中断与状态丢失问题。值得关注的是它把基础设施层的可靠性、审计和恢复作为AI Agent落地的关键。
zh.failureAnalysis: 长时程自主代理在真实生产环境中仍面临任务漂移和不可预测性，'新上下文执行'可能牺牲上下文连续性，导致复杂流程失败。同时，独立审计与持久化状态会带来额外基础设施开销，小团队难以维护。内置类似能力的Claude Code和Codex可能挤压其生存空间，而企业对该类型工具的安全性和合规性要求也会限制推广。

en.highlight: Run AI agents across desktop apps and the CLI for extended periods while preserving task state and making reliable progress on complex workflows.
en.summary: This repository presents a long-horizon computer-use harness that runs agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw across desktop and CLI environments for extended tasks. Its mechanisms include fresh-context execution, durable verified state, independent auditing, and recoverable progress, which address interruptions and state loss in complex workflows. It is worth reading because it treats reliability, auditability, and recovery as core infrastructure for deploying AI agents.
en.failureAnalysis: Long-horizon autonomous agents still risk task drift and unpredictability, and fresh-context execution may break contextual continuity on complex workflows. The extra overhead of auditing and durable state, plus competition from built-in agent capabilities, could limit adoption outside well-resourced or highly controlled environments.
en.title: LongHorizon-Harness: Running AI Agents for Long-Horizon Workflows Across Desktop and CLI
